title: Procedure for reductive methylation of protein to improve crystallizability
protocol: Pipette out 1ml of 10mg/ml protein sample in two 1.5ml eppendorf tubes.
Cover the tubes with aluminum foil.
Add 20 μl of 1M DMAB solution followed by 40 μL of 1M formaldehyde solution to the "methylated" tube.
Shake both the tubes at 4 °C in dark on a gel shaker maintained at 100 rpm for 2 h.
Add 20 μl of 1M DMAB solution followed by 40 μL of 1M formaldehyde solution to the "methylated" tube again.
Shake both the tubes at 4 °C in dark on a gel shaker maintained at 100 rpm for 2 h again.
Add 10 μL of DMAB and incubate for 12 h at 4 °C in the dark while shaking.
Run size exclusion chromatography on "control" and "methylated" protein using 20mM Tris, 150mM NaCl, pH8.0 for buffer exchange.
Analyze proteins using SDS PAGE and mass spectroscopy.
Screen control and methylated protein for crystallization under identical conditions.
